WEB-1301 (S3), one failed call isn't ‘the live demo is off’. `failureFor` (`:63-96`) groups the API's `unavailable` with the deliberate pauses (`paused`, `budget_pause`, `not_ready`, `budget_config`, `:67-72`). The server answers `503 unavailable` for any unexpected error (`src/lib/voice/security.ts:191-208`), including errors after the try was recorded (`src/app/api/voice/draft/route.ts:79-100`): an AI error or quota refusal, the model's 35 s timeout, an answer that isn't JSON. So the visitor's typed text or recording gives way to the static example and ‘The live demo is off for now…’, with no Try again, though the demo isn't off; and since the model gives up at 35 s and the page at 40 s, a slow call usually ends there too (renders `voice-error-unavailable.*`, `voice-connect-unavailable.*`). Do this. (1) In `failureFor`, give `unavailable` its own case: the message `t.errors.notAnswering` (unchanged: EN `The demo isn’t answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.` / ES `La demo no responde ahora mismo. Vuelve a probar en unos minutos.` / CA `La demo no respon ara mateix. Torna-ho a provar d’aquí a uns minuts.`), not `off`, with Try again, but as a new request, because the server answers a failed request's ID only with `previous_failure` (`src/lib/voice/store.ts:72-76`). Add a flag to `Failure` (for example `fresh: true`, alongside `retry: true`) that keeps the typed text in its box, or the recording for Try again (`.voice-retry`, `:969-986`), but clears `requestId.current`, so `submit` makes a new ID (`:528`); say what it means in the comment above `Failure` (`:51-52`). If that failure used the last try, the new request is refused as `visitor_limit` and the tries-used stage shows, as for any new request. (2) On opening, `statusFailed` (`:368-375`) with `unavailable` no longer turns the demo off: the connecting stage shows the alert and its filled Try again (`:804-816`), as for any failed opening. (3) Keep the off stage only for `paused`, `budget_pause`, `not_ready` and `budget_config`, and end it with the existing hand-over line, as the unverified stage does (`:1122-1128`): `

{t.handOver}

WEB-1314 (S1), on older Safari the wait never ends. `submit` calls `crypto.randomUUID()` (`:528`; missing before Safari 15.4) and `AbortSignal.timeout(40_000)` (`:535`; missing before Safari 16, so on iOS 15, as on an iPhone 6s or 7) before its `try` and after `setBusy(true)`: the call throws, no request is made, and ‘Understanding…’ stays for good. Stop waiting has no request to stop, and Close demo then Try the live demo opens the same stage, because `startAgain` (`:656-676`) never clears `busy`, which outranks every later stage (`:269-283`). `record()` calls `crypto.randomUUID()` too (`:482`). Do this. (1) One helper for request IDs: `crypto.randomUUID()` when it exists, otherwise a version-4 UUID from `crypto.getRandomValues`, lower-case, in exactly the form the server accepts (`/^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/`, `src/app/api/voice/draft/route.ts:41-46`); use it at `:482` and `:528`. (2) The page's 40 s limit uses `AbortSignal.timeout` when it exists, otherwise a `setTimeout` of 40 s that aborts the same way and is cleared in the `finally`. (3) Whatever throws while `submit` sets up or sends ends in its `catch`, with `errors.notAnswering` and Try again and `busy` false: never a lasting ‘Understanding…’. (4) `startAgain` also sets `busy` to false and `waiting.current` to null, so Close demo always resets the demo.

decisions.question: Tell visitors that tasks can repeat (‘every Monday’, «cada día a las 9», or More details › Repeat)?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, as one new FAQ item after ‘How do I add tasks by voice?’, in review F's copy, and nowhere else: never paired with the ‘more and more often’ reminders, which repeating tasks don't get.
decisions.context: Review F. The app repeats tasks in all three languages: say ‘every Monday’ or «cada día a las 9», or use More details › Repeat, and each time shows on the calendar with its own reminder (`Backend/core/ai.py:82-85, 353-357`; `App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:258, 604`). The site never says so (0 hits for repeat in `src/content/site/`); for a Comparer it's table stakes. Copy (review F): EN Q ‘Can I add something that repeats?’ A ‘Yes. Say “every Monday” or “every day at 9” when you add it, or tap More details and choose Repeat. Each time shows on your calendar, and TaskFlow can remind you.’ / ES «¿Puedo añadir algo que se repite?» «Sí. Di «todos los lunes» o «cada día a las 9» al añadirlo, o toca Más detalles y elige Repetir. Cada vez aparece en tu calendario, y TaskFlow puede recordártelo.» / CA «Puc afegir una cosa que es repeteix?» «Sí. Digues «cada dilluns» o «cada dia a les 9» quan l’afegeixis, o toca Més detalls i tria Repetició. Cada vegada surt al calendari, i TaskFlow t’ho pot recordar.» Against: a ninth FAQ item. The live demo writes a repeat into the task's notes and can't show it, so keep the claim away from the ‘Try it’ links; avoid medical examples (privacy §4).

decisions.question: Say what's free in the hero, in the first phone screen, rather than only under the demo (WD2's placement)?

decisions.context: Reviews H1 and F. Today nothing about cost is in the first screen; the free and Pro line first shows about 3.2 phone screens down, under the demo, and ‘Is TaskFlow free?’ about 6.4 (WD2 placed it so). The guide asks for the cost within a line of the button and for every ‘free’ to carry its limit (CT-10, PR-2, PR-3); the Newcomer is wary of paying. (a) Review H1: a third line under the status: EN ‘Free with an account: 10 dictations a month, and tasks by hand with no limit.’ / ES «Gratis con una cuenta: 10 dictados al mes y tareas a mano sin límite.» / CA «Gratuït amb un compte: 10 dictats al mes i tasques a mà sense límit.» It costs about two lines of the phone's first screen, and the quote card slips below the fold. (b) Review F: the status starts ‘Free with an account.’, as in EN ‘Free with an account. Coming soon to Google Play. You can’t download it yet.’ (ES and CA likewise): shorter, but ‘free’ without its limit. (c) Keep WD2's placement. Pro stays where WD2 put it in every option.
